title: Zero an Optical Dial Micrometer
instructions: 1. Inspect optical faces and perform a single linear wipe with lint-free paper. 2. Advance spindle gently until ratchet stop engages. 3. Turn ratchet stop for exactly 3 steady clicks. 4. Wait for indicator needle to settle, then engage spindle lock lever.

constraints.description: Complete complete zeroing sequence within 45 seconds
Use 0-25mm optical dial micrometer with 0.001mm graduation
